title: Underlying sets of module pullback section comparisons
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $G$ an etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $G_{\rm set}$ be its underlying sheaf of sets. For each morphism $f:Y\to X$ and etale object $U\to X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], put $S_f(U)=(f_*f^{-1}G)(U)$ using [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and $A_f(U)=(f^{-1}G_{\rm set})(U\times_XY)$ using [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. There are simultaneous bijections $e_{f,U}:S_f(U)\to A_f(U)$ with the following compatibility. For $h:Z\to Y$, $k:Z\to X$ and $hf=k$, let $m_{h,f,k}:S_f(U)\to S_k(U)$ be evaluation at $U$ of $f_*(\eta_h(f^{-1}G))$, followed by the direct-image composition isomorphism $f_*h_*\cong k_*$ and then $k_*$ of the inverse-image composition isomorphism $h^{-1}f^{-1}G\cong k^{-1}G$ [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. For every $s\in S_f(U)$,
$$e_{k,U}(m_{h,f,k}(s))=r_{h,f,k}(e_{f,U}(s)),$$
where $r_{h,f,k}$ is the canonical set section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison], including restriction along the fibre-product pasting isomorphism. No limiting diagram, colimit, affineness, quasi-compactness, or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the proved isIso_upperStar_forget_comparison to define the module-to-set inverse-image isomorphism as the adjoint transpose of the forgotten module unit. Its unit equation follows by apply_symm_apply of the set adjunction. Evaluate its inverse on the base change of U to define sectionEquiv.

Use upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app from UpperLowerStar.Coherence and cancel the direct-image composition isomorphism to derive module_pre_comp_unit. The chosen set composition isomorphism satisfies set_comp_unit by clause (2) of etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits. Apply injectivity of the set adjunction hom equivalence and the two unit equations; naturality of the direct-image composition isomorphism gives forget_transition.

Evaluate forget_transition at the base change of U and the inverse comparison image of s. Cancel the comparison isomorphism. Naturality of the module composition isomorphism and the inverse coefficient comparison along the pullback-pasting morphism gives the desired equality including restriction. Substitute k using hk; unfold the section formula and identify the chosen set composition by proof irrelevance.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_modulePullbackSectionComparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X) (U : X.Etale),
      (((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj G)).obj.obj (op U)) ≃
      (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj
        ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj G)).obj.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj U))),
      ∀ (Y Z : Scheme.{u}) (h : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ X)
        (hk : h ≫ f = k) (U : X.Etale)
        (s : ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj G)).obj.obj (op U)),
        e Z k U
          ((((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).map
            ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) h).unit.app
              ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj G)) ≫
            (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) h f k hk.symm).hom.app _ ≫
            (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) k).map
              ((upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) h f k hk.symm).inv.app G)).hom.app
                (op U)) s) =
          etaleSetSectionComparison h f k hk
            ((sheafForget X.smallEtaleTopology).obj G) U (e Y f U s)
